title: Beyond Fidelity: Evaluating Synthetic Medical Imaging Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing use of synthetic medical imaging datasets (SMD) in the development and evaluation of machine learning models has motivated interest in systematic methods to assess dataset quality across different imaging modalities. Common evaluation strategies rely heavily on fidelity-oriented metrics developed for general computer vision and may not capture clinically relevant properties such as anatomical plausibility, dataset coverage, metadata completeness, subgroup consistency, or documentation quality. We present the ScoreCard Toolkit that operationalizes six of the seven dimensions found within the 7Cs approach for SMD evaluation across Congruence, Coverage, Completeness, Consistency, Constraint, and Comprehension. The ScoreCard Toolkit provides a modular pipeline for preprocessing, feature extraction, metric computation, visualization, and structured scorecard generation. translated_title: 超越保真度：评估合成医学影像数据
translated_abstract: 合成医学影像数据集（SMD）在机器学习模型的开发和评估中的应用日益增多，这促使人们关注跨不同成像模态系统评估数据集质量的方法。常见的评估策略主要依赖于为通用计算机视觉开发的面向保真度的指标，可能无法捕捉临床相关特性，如解剖学合理性、数据集覆盖度、元数据完整性、子组一致性或文档质量。我们提出了ScoreCard工具包，该工具包将用于SMD评估的7Cs方法中的七个维度中的六个进行了可操作化实现，涵盖契合性、覆盖度、完整性、一致性、约束性和可理解性。ScoreCard工具包提供了一个模块化流水线，用于预处理、特征提取、指标计算、可视化以及结构化评分卡生成。该方法对标准的基于保真度的评估方法进行了补充。
tldr: 提出了ScoreCard工具包，通过可操作化实现7Cs评估框架中的六个维度（契合性、覆盖度、完整性、一致性、约束性和可理解性），为合成医学影像数据集提供了超越传统保真度指标、贴合临床需求的系统化质量评估方案。
en_tdlr: The ScoreCard Toolkit operationalizes six dimensions of the 7Cs framework (Congruence, Coverage, Completeness, Consistency, Constraint, and Comprehension) to systematically evaluate synthetic medical imaging datasets beyond traditional fidelity-based metrics.
